blocks.input_voltage: 5 V VBUS from external USB host/charger (4.75-5.25 V)
required_inputs: External USB-C cable: VBUS 5 V, D+, D-, CC1, CC2, GND
required_outputs: USB_D+ / USB_D- differential pair (90 Ohm, matched within 5 mm)
blocks.type: USB-C receptacle (power input + USB 2.0 FS data), replaces USB_B_Micro J1; CC1/CC2 5.1 kOhm pull-downs for UFP 5V default; edge-flush placement with 3 mm keepout

5V-to-3.3V LDO regulator, >=600 mA continuous (e.g. AP2112K-class not sufficient; use 600 mA+ LDO such as AP7361C/TLV757P-3.3), with 10 uF bulk input (VBUS) and output (+3V3) capacitors and 100 nF locals

required_inputs: USB_D+ / USB_D- differential pair from usb_c_input
blocks.type: ESP32-WROOM-32 module (U1): Wi-Fi MCU, I2C master on GPIO21/GPIO22, native USB D+/D- endpoint, spare GPIO25; antenna keepout >=15x15 mm copper-free at board edge; 100 nF per supply pin + local bulk decoupling

TMP102 I2C temperature sensor (U2): VCC->+3V3, GND->GND (fixing current miswiring), ADD0 strapped to GND via resistor for deterministic address 0x48; placed >=10 mm from ESP32 and regulator with minimal copper for thermal isolation; 100 nF local decoupling

required_outputs: Passive bias holding SDA/SCL high when idle
blocks.type: I2C pull-up network: 4.7 kOhm resistors from SDA and SCL to +3V3, sized for 100 kHz standard mode with one target device

required_outputs: EN signal with power-on-reset delay to U1.EN
blocks.type: ESP32 EN reset network: 10 kOhm pull-up from EN to +3V3 plus 100 nF from EN to GND (replaces the current direct EN-to-+3V3 tie)

required_outputs: ERC power-driven declaration on VBUS, +3V3, GND
blocks.type: ERC power-flag set: exactly one PWR_FLAG on each of VBUS, +3V3, and GND (reassigning/removing the existing duplicate #FLG01/#FLG02 placement)

connections.signal: VBUS_5V (5 V power rail, >=0.5 mm trace, 10 uF bulk cap)
USB_D+/USB_D- (USB 2.0 full-speed 90 Ohm differential pair, length-matched within 5 mm, continuous GND plane underneath)
+3V3 (3.3 V power rail, minimal copper spur for thermal isolation)
I2C_SDA / I2C_SCL pull-up bias (4.7 kOhm to +3V3)
EN (power-on reset, 10 kOhm pull-up + 100 nF RC)
GND (common ground plane; also ADD0 strap reference)

unresolved_questions: PWR-003 (>=600 mA on 3.3 V for Wi-Fi TX peaks) vs PWR-004 (<=500 mA total from VBUS) conflict: peaks must be absorbed by bulk capacitance or the USB budget re-justified; confirm which requirement governs.
Concrete LDO part selection (>=600 mA, low dropout at 5 V input, <50 mVpp ripple) and its thermal dissipation (~0.85 W worst case at 500 mA) on a 2-layer board need component-engineer confirmation.

USB data endpoint: pin table names U1 pins 6/7 as USB_D+/USB_D-, but ESP32-WROOM-32 has no native USB; confirm whether these are GPIO-mapped, a serial-bridge IC should be added, or USB data is unused (power-only USB-C with D+/D- left NC).
ADD0 strap level proposed as GND (address 0x48) via 10 kOhm; confirm no address conflict constraints.
Target board size reduction to <=60 x 40 mm from 110 x 65 mm: confirm the smaller outline is adopted at layout stage given the 15x15 mm antenna keepout and USB-C edge keepout.
Specific USB-C receptacle part (16-pin USB 2.0-only type preferred for generic_two_layer manufacturability) to be chosen by the component engineer.
